title: Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign
text:
Super Soakerz was a student-led car window washing service created for a marketing course at Cal Poly Pomona. The project focused on building a service brand from scratch, promoting it to students, and measuring real customer response through campus outreach.
The campaign positioned Super Soakerz as a convenient, affordable, and student-run service for busy commuter students who wanted a quick way to clean their car windows while on campus.

title: Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign

The campaign positioned Super Soakerz as a convenient, affordable, and student-run service for busy commuter students who wanted a quick way to clean their car windows while on campus.

title: Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign
text:
Objective
The main objective was to create and promote a small service-based business while applying marketing concepts such as target market selection, positioning, pricing, promotion, and customer engagement.

title: Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign
text:
Target Audience
The target audience was Cal Poly Pomona students, especially commuter students between the ages of 18 and 25 who drive to campus and may not have time to regularly clean their car windows.

title: Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign
text:
My Role
For this project, I contributed to the campaign planning, customer outreach, service promotion, and overall marketing strategy. I helped shape the project’s messaging around convenience, affordability, and student-to-student service.

title: Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign
text:
Campaign Strategy
The campaign used simple and direct messaging to attract students on campus. The strategy focused on:

Promoting the service as quick and affordable
Reaching students through in-person campus outreach
Building trust by presenting the service as student-run
Using clear pricing and simple service benefits
Emphasizing convenience for commuter students

The purpose of this dashboard is to turn marketing data into clear insights. Instead of only showing numbers, the dashboard helps explain patterns, trends, and possible recommendations.



R · Quarto · ggplot2 · Excel · Google Analytics 4 · Data Visualization



Marketing analytics · Data cleaning · Visual storytelling · Consumer insights · Performance tracking · Insight communication









Tracks how users interact with marketing content, campaigns, or website pages.



Shows how marketing efforts perform based on engagement, reach, traffic, or other results.



Uses data to better understand audience behavior, preferences, and trends.







Marketing analytics helps connect creative decisions with measurable results. By reviewing data, marketers can better understand what is working, what needs improvement, and how to make stronger campaign decisions.
For example, if a campaign receives strong traffic but low engagement, the issue may be the message, call-to-action, or audience targeting. A dashboard makes it easier to identify these issues and explain them clearly.






This dashboard helped me practice using data to support marketing strategy. I learned that strong marketing is not only about creative ideas, but also about measuring results and using insights to improve future decisions.

title: Google Analytics
text:
This page highlights my understanding of Google Analytics and how it connects to digital marketing strategy.
Google Analytics helps marketers understand how users find, visit, and interact with websites. It can be used to measure traffic, engagement, conversions, and audience behavior.



Google Analytics is important because it helps marketers make decisions based on data instead of guessing. It can show which pages are getting attention, where visitors are coming from, and what content is helping reach marketing goals.

Measuring user engagement

Identifying audience behavior

Evaluating campaign performance

For my portfolio, Google Analytics connects to the goal of understanding how visitors interact with my website. This can help me improve the site, strengthen my personal brand, and make the portfolio more useful for future employers.




Learning Google Analytics helps me connect marketing strategy with measurable results. It also shows that I can think beyond creative ideas and understand how performance is tracked.
